headline: Pin, fill, and a safer board
summary: Keep RefBoard above other windows, erase objects from images with a lasso fill, and recover the last good board after a crash.

new.title: Always on top
new.description: A pin in the title bar keeps RefBoard above other windows, or attached above a window you pick.

new.title: Content-aware fill
new.description: Press C or use the wand next to Draw, lasso something on an image, and release to erase and fill from nearby pixels. Undo restores the original. Shared copies stay untouched.

improved.title: Softer fill edges
improved.description: The fill blends a few pixels at the lasso rim instead of leaving a hard cut.

improved.title: Black and Tide themes
improved.description: Two new appearance themes in settings.

improved.title: Clearer rotate cursor
improved.description: Corner rotate uses a 32px PureRef-style cursor.

fixed.title: Wheel over the pin list
fixed.description: Scrolling the "always on top of" window list no longer zooms the board.

fixed.title: Last good board after a crash
fixed.description: RefBoard keeps a last-good copy so a crash is less likely to lose the board you were working on.
